init_distributed_mode: init distributed training mode from environment variables for multi-GPU PyTorch jobs using NCCL backend
get_model: get the underlying model module from a DataParallel or DistributedDataParallel wrapped PyTorch model
save_on_master: save checkpoint state dict to disk only on the main process during distributed training
is_main_process: check if the current process is the main process with rank zero in a distributed job
setup_for_distributed: setup distributed print suppression so only the master process outputs log messages
